title: DEMO EXTRACTION: SCORE X2, RUN OVER
why: His mode design and his answer 8 of 2026-10-12: extraction gives a 2x bonus to the score, and it doubles the whole raid score and ends the run. A DEMO extraction used to pay a 2,500 bonus plus the haul again and drop you straight back into the same raid. Now a finished pull (or being hauled aboard while down) doubles the score and ends the run: RUN OVER with EXTRACTED x2 and the doubled score counting up, then the initials if it makes the board. In the 2 player demo either player extracting doubles both scores and ends the run for both windows.
now: Extracting in the demo doubles your score and ends the run.
